bullets: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: skip UWP AssemblyInfo.cs / assembly-attribute-only .cs at copy time, since SDK-style WinUI 3 auto-generates those attributes and copying them causes a guaranteed CS0579 duplicate-assembly-attribute flood in every UWP migration.

MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: add CS0579 (delete AssemblyInfo.cs) and single-file CS0111/CS0102/CS0106 duplicate-body (overwrite the whole file) entries so the agent maps these recurring build errors to their fix in one cycle.
